systems.tiers: national; compiled from documents available to the Registrar, holding for each resident a birth entry number and identity number, the particulars given at notice of birth and of death, and from age 16 a photograph and fingerprints

note: The 1998 Order founding the population register, identity numbers and identity documents: a legal text on identity enrolment that takes the particulars of birth and death notices into the register but does not say how or where a birth or death is recorded; no civil-class fact.
